verdict.rationale: Proton documents end-to-end encryption of every item field it stores and syncs (docs-10), and offers a PGP-encrypted export as a backup option (docs-11). Open-source clients give some auditability of the crypto (comm-6, though comm-3 notes only clients are open). Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Proton never holds the decryption keys, a published encryption design or whitepaper, details of key derivation and management for the sync/backup copy, and independent audit or hands-on corroboration.
